endorsements.label: Smart Card Security: From GSM to Parking Meters
endorsements.description: Smart Card Security: From GSM to Parking Meters Smart Cards are used all over the place in every day life. The unfortunate (or fortunate) side of Smart Cards is that most widely deployed systems don't use any real security and rely mostly on obscurity. This presentation will discuss the different types of Smart Cards, exactly how to reverse engineer the protocols they use, and how to exploit their security weaknesses. For demonstration, we will look at GSM SIM Cards and San Diego Parking Meter Debit Cards and show how their security can be defeated.
